annotations.title: Redact a document already checked with detect_pii

description: Produce the redacted PDF of a document you already checked with detect_pii, using the job_id it returned. Without pii_categories / pii_included_terms / pii_excluded_terms / mode, the detection's own settings apply; pass any of them to change what is removed. The document is analysed again with those settings, so the result matches what detect_pii reported unless a setting changed. No new upload and no extra charge (the detection already counted the pages). Waits for the result like redact_pdf_and_wait. An ephemeral job can be redacted for one hour after its detection; after that the original is gone and the user must upload the file again. Writes the PDF to output_path (default "<document_id>-redacted.pdf" in the working directory). In pseudonymize mode the result also carries document_text and the correspondence table path, as with redact_pdf_and_wait.

mode.description: "redact" (default) draws black boxes. "pseudonymize" replaces each person, organization, address, email, phone number, date, IBAN and card number with a consistent tag such as [Person 1] or [Org 2] (spelled in the document's language, e.g. [Personne 1] in French) — the same tag on every page and, as a rule, for every variant of a name ("Anna Keller", "Ms Keller", "A. Keller" become [Person 1]; a bare surname shared by two people goes to the one mentioned last, and the user can merge or split tags in the Studio) — so the document stays readable for a colleague or another AI while the names are gone. The text is still removed from the file, not covered. With pseudonymize, redact_pdf_and_wait also returns the tag -> original correspondence table (CSV; on the hosted server as a download link for the user, never inline); keep it with the user, it re-identifies the document. Other categories (national IDs, custom terms) stay black.

output_path.description: Where to write the redacted PDF on this machine. Defaults to the input path with a "-redacted" suffix, next to the original. Output is always a PDF, so an image input produces a .pdf file. The original file is never modified.

pii_categories.description: Which entity types to redact. OMIT this to use the account defaults, which is usually what the user wants — do not pass an empty list, which would mean "redact nothing" and return an unredacted file. Valid values: Person, Email, PhoneNumber, Address, Organization, Date, IBAN, CreditCard.

pii_excluded_terms.description: Terms that must NEVER be redacted even if detected as PII — typically your own company name, a public contact address, or the recipient the document is addressed to.

pii_included_terms.description: Terms that must ALWAYS be redacted even when the model would not treat them as PII — project codenames, internal references, a specific case number. Matched whole-word and case-insensitive. Wins over excluded terms on conflict.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for completion, in seconds (default 300, max 900; on the hosted server never more than 180, whatever is asked). On timeout the job keeps running server-side and can be resumed with get_job_status.
